surface_mechanism_description: The decomposed or partially decomposed TMGa precursor interacts with the copper substrate to form different (Ga, Cu) metallic alloys, and then the 3D structures are formed, as described by the VLS mechanism. Ga can be responsible for the catalyst effect already mentioned for other 3D structure compounds. The Ga ball formation can represent the first growth step of the 3D structure. The TMGa interaction with Cu substrate (and surface Cu oxide) would be the subsequent step to the CuGa x O y wire growth.
